blocks.h2: What Does a Catch Basin Do?
blocks.body: A catch basin is a buried box with a grate. It collects runoff from your yard, driveway or downspouts and sends it into a storm line. The bottom sits lower than the outlet, so silt and leaves settle there instead of clogging the pipe. Once the bottom fills, debris moves into the outlet, the pipe clogs and water backs up into the yard.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

blocks.h2: Signs Your Catch Basin Needs Help

tiles.h3: Mulch and Leaves Cover the Grate

tiles.body: Soil is washing into a crack.

blocks.intro: Many Algonquin subdivisions use yard basins to move water off flat lots and long driveways.

items.body: Well-kept beds near basins send mulch into the grate with every heavy rain.
Irrigation adds water to the basin even in dry weeks, so a partly clogged basin stays wet.
High groundwater slows drainage, and a blocked basin leaves standing water for days.
A working basin keeps water away from the foundation and eases the load on your [sump pump](/algonquin/sump-pumps).

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Algonquin Homeowners

items.q: How often should I clean my catch basin?
items.preview: Once a year, ideally in late fall.
items.answer: Once a year in late fall works for most yards. Heavily landscaped yards may need a spring cleaning too.

items.q: Why is my yard still soggy with a catch basin?
items.preview: The basin or outlet is clogged, or it's undersized.
items.answer: Either the basin or outlet is clogged, or the basin can't handle the area draining to it. We'll check both.

items.q: Can you add a catch basin?
items.preview: Yes, where there's a place to drain it.
items.answer: Yes, if there's a storm line or outlet nearby to connect to. We'll look at your yard and tell you what's possible.

items.q: Is the basin in my yard mine to maintain?
items.preview: Usually, if it drains your property.
items.answer: Usually. If it's on your lot and handles your yard or driveway, it's the homeowner's.

items.q: Can my downspouts connect to a catch basin?
items.preview: Often, if the basin and outlet can handle the flow.
items.answer: Often. Tying downspouts into a catch basin keeps roof water away from the foundation, as long as the basin and its outlet can carry the extra flow.

items.q: What does catch basin repair cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on the work. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it needs cleaning, a new grate, wall repair or outlet work. We quote a flat rate before we start.
